    data = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    head = data[0]
    body = data[1:]
    
    # Locate "at" position
    pos = 0
    found = False
    while pos < len(body) - 1:
        if body[pos] == 'a' and body[pos+1] == 't':
            found = True
            break
        pos += 1
    
    if found:
        part1 = body[:pos+2]
        part2 = body[pos+2:]
    else:
        part1 = body
        part2 = ""
    
    # Apply dot replacements
    part1 = part1.replace("dot", ".")
    part2 = part2.replace("dot", ".")
    part1 = part1.replace("at", "@")
    
    return head + part1 + part2
